name: Copper Star Home Medical Supplies
old_description: Copper Star Home Medical has been Phoenix’s locally trusted home medical equipment store for over 22 years. With the largest medical supply showroom in Arizona, if you need it, there’s a good chance we have it. Whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing a chronic condition, or looking for equipment that makes daily life safer and more comfortable at home, our Phoenix store has what you need. That includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and home oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living.
about:
Copper Star Home Medical Supplies operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has served the metropolitan area for over 22 years. The company runs what it describes as the largest medical supply showroom in the state, with additional locations in Tempe, Mesa, and Surprise. Ownership structure and founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The retailer stocks a broad range of durable medical equipment for sale or weekly and monthly rental. Inventory includes power lift chairs, hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers, rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and stationary oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and daily living aids. All showroom units are fully assembled for hands‑on evaluation before purchase or rental.

Customers include patients recovering from surgery, individuals managing chronic conditions, seasonal “snowbird” residents, and caregivers. The company works directly with Medicare, Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona, Devoted Health, Homelink, Integrated Home Care Services, One Call, and Prospect Medical Group, and accepts FSA and HSA payments. Healthcare professionals also refer patients for equipment fitting and procurement.

Copper Star emphasizes a consultative approach: staff help clients decide between renting and buying, navigate insurance coverage, and select equipment suited to Arizona’s climate and the needs of an aging population. Its Bell Road location sits near HonorHealth Deer Valley Medical Center and Mayo Clinic Hospital, supporting post‑discharge transitions.
